Let $ D, E, $ and $ F $ be the midpoints of sides $ \overline{BC} $, $ \overline{AC} $, and $ \overline{AB} $, respectively. The points $ G, D, E, H, J, $ and $ F $ divide the circumcircle of $ \triangle DEF $ into six minor arcs, as shown. Find $ \widehat{DE} + 2 \cdot \widehat{HJ} + 3 \cdot \widehat{FG} $, where the arcs are measured in degrees.
